title: Would you still call this Dax? Novel Visual References in VLMs and Humans
abstract: arXiv:2606.05409v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs), like human learners, are frequently exposed to new visual concepts, but how they map novel visual references to language after exposure remains largely underexplored, particularly when those references contradict prior knowledge from pre-training. To study this, we present the Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD): 19,176 images spanning 90 visual concepts across different levels of visual novelty, each with up to 20 increasingly perturbed versions of the original object to probe generalization. Unlike prior work on visual augmentations of familiar concepts, NVRD comprises entirely novel, open-ended stimuli constructed from scratch, mirroring how humans encounter genuinely new concepts. We evaluate 3 open- and 2 closed-source models alongside 2,400 human judgments for direct human-model comparison, and find that (i) models struggle to acquire novel concepts in-context when they contradict prior k

translated_title: 你还会称它为Dax吗？视觉语言模型与人类的新颖视觉指称
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）与人类学习者一样，会频繁接触到新的视觉概念，但它们在接触之后如何将这些新颖的视觉指称映射到语言上，仍然在很大程度上未被充分探索，尤其是当这些指称与预训练所获得的先验知识相矛盾时。为了研究这一问题，我们提出了新颖视觉指称数据集（NVRD）：包含19,176张图像，涵盖90个具有不同视觉新颖程度的视觉概念，每个原始物体都配有最多20个扰动程度递增的版本，以探究泛化能力。与以往针对熟悉概念进行视觉增强的研究不同，NVRD完全由从零构建的、开放式的全新刺激组成，模拟了人类遇到真正新概念的方式。我们评估了3个开源模型和2个闭源模型，并结合2,400条人类判断进行直接的人机对比，发现：(i) 当新颖概念与模型先验知识相矛盾时，模型难以在上下文中习得这些概念……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了完全从零设计的新颖视觉指称数据集NVRD（19,176张图像、90个视觉概念），通过人类与模型的直接对比，揭示视觉语言模型在面对与预训练先验知识相矛盾的新颖视觉概念时，难以像人类那样在上下文中习得这些概念。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NVRD, a from-scratch dataset of 19,176 images spanning 90 novel visual concepts, and through direct human-model comparison (3 open- and 2 closed-source models vs. 2,400 human judgments) shows that VLMs struggle to acquire novel visual concepts in-context when those concepts contradict their pre-trained prior knowledge.
